sentences.en: As we are approaching our 300th episode of the show,
sentences.zh: 随着我们节目的第300期临近，

sentences.en: the 99PI crew took a couple days to go on a retreat up the coast and listen to audio that inspires us and talk about the future of the show.
sentences.zh: 99PI团队花了几几天时间去海岸边度假放松，聆听启发我们的音频，并讨论节目的未来。

sentences.en: Because of all the time it took to plan and execute the retreat, we have one of our rare rebroadcasts this week,
sentences.zh: 由于策划和执行这次度假花费了大量时间，我们本周将进行一次难得的重播，

sentences.en: and I'm happy to revisit it because this is a pivotal episode for 99% Invisible and one of my personal favorites.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意再次回顾它，因为这是《99%无形》的关键一集，也是我个人最喜欢的节目之一。

sentences.en: It was a really ambitious story for Avery at the time, and we knew it was going to be important, so we commissioned an original score for the first time from Sean Rial,
sentences.zh: 对当时的埃弗里来说，这是一个雄心勃勃的故事，我们知道它非常重要，所以我们首次委托肖恩·里亚尔创作了原创配乐，

sentences.en: who later came on staff to be our full-time composer.
sentences.zh: 他后来加入了我们的全职作曲团队。

sentences.en: If you haven't heard this episode, you're in for a real treat.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没听过这一集，你将大饱耳福。

sentences.en: And if you have, you should listen again because I think it gets better each time.
sentences.zh: 如果你听过了，你应该再听一遍，因为我觉得每次听都会更好。

sentences.en: Stay tuned to the end because we're going to have a brand new interview with Sean that I conducted late last night on the foggy California coast about the score for this episode and the process of composing music for nerds to talk over.
